status: User-selected visual direction; requested yellow and gray stud refinement applied. Complete screen and native acceptance remain pending.
direction: Royal purple structure, soft yellow headers and selection outlines, dimensional grey stud surfaces, native Roblox display and body fonts

roles.header: Soft yellow (Cool yellow BrickColor) is the user-selected default for title bars and active category
roles.card: Grey stud surfaces across ball cards, item label bands, selected-ball details, inactive category buttons and other grey panels
roles.close: Bright red reserved for close/error controls, not broad branding surfaces
roles.text: White outlined display text; Black body text on Light stone grey copy panels
roles.selection: Match the soft-yellow header for selected card and detail outlines, active-tab border, checkmark backing and selected badge

display.style: Normal; genuine heavy display face, no synthetic bold, no wide tracking or italics

interface.outline: No outline on small copy; place it on a solid recessed surface

fontVerification.method: Read installed Roblox content/fonts/families JSON, inspected font name tables and embedded those exact local TrueType files; no external font dependency in preview

treatments: Keep the accepted raised square stud treatment on purple structure and title bars
Extend matching gray stud relief to every gray surface: tiles, name strips, detail panel, description well, inactive category buttons and Fusion panel
Keep sphere and icon artwork unchanged above the surface texture
Use half-strength gray relief beneath small description/body copy for legibility
Match selected card, selected detail and active category outlines to the soft-yellow header; retain the checkmark and selected label
Keep current crisp borders, bevels, exact fonts, layout and category behavior
scope: Visual direction proposal only; no runtime source edits, new gameplay or benchmark implementation
gameplay: Keep existing cyan/coral team identities and territory meaning; do not recolor gameplay by cosmetic palette.
pending: Complete Inventory and Store mockups, including all appearances and phone layouts
Verify the refined gray texture and yellow selection styling at native Roblox sizes

preview: Updated contained Inventory style sample with soft-yellow default, gray stud material and matching selected outlines. Category switching, selection/equip, close/reopen and responsive layout preserved.
browserQA: Static markup, source, selector and JavaScript syntax checks only; exact fonts embedded. No rendered browser QA claimed.
contrastMethod: Calculated solid sRGB foreground/background pairs only. Gradients, raised highlights and outlines also affect rendered appearance; native Studio and phone visual approval remains pending.

brickColorReference.note: Base colors are exact BrickColor RGB values; bevel lighting and shadow tints are derived.
